exam_scheme.note: The Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design (UCEED) is conducted by IIT Bombay for admissions to the Bachelor of Design (B.Des) programmes at IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Hyderabad, and IIITDM Jabalpur, along with numerous result-sharing institutes. UCEED is a 3-hour examination consisting of two parts: Part A is a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 120 minutes duration carrying 200 marks, divided into Section 1 Numerical Answer Type (NAT, 14 questions, 56 marks), Section 2 Multiple Select Questions (MSQ, 15 questions, 60 marks), and Section 3 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ, 28 questions, 84 marks). Part B is an offline paper-based drawing test of 60 minutes duration carrying 100 marks (2 questions testing sketching and design aptitude).
